newsitem.title: USA: N.H. approves $8.2 mln of revenue bonds.
newsitem.headline: N.H. approves $8.2 mln of revenue bonds.

text.p: New Hampshire's Executive Council authorized the issuance of $8.2 million in industrial revenue bonds Thursday in two private placements arranged by the Business Finance Authority.
Under New Hampshire law, the Authority, a state agency, finances industral programs that have relatively small price tags by placing the bonds directly with approved financial institutions.
Executive Director Jack Donovan told the Council that the authority has now placed 1,000 of these bonds in its three years of existence.
New Hamphire's Executive Council must approve all state contracts and borrowings. The approved financings include:

-- $1.65 million to KSH Realty LLC and Alene Candles, Inc. of Milford in two separate issues. The money will be used to acquire land and equipment for a candle-making factory that will create about 100 jobs.

The bonds were placed with Primary Bank, Milford. A $1.4 million real estate acquisition bond will run 20 years and carry a 7.425 percent interest rate. A $225,000 equipment bond will run 5-1/2 years and carry 7.5 percent interest.

-- $6.5 million to Upper Valley Press Inc., to build a new printing facility in Haverhill that will employ 110. The bonds were placed with KeyBank NA, Burlington, Vt., and will mature in 2017. The interest rate is variable and can be converted to an 8.25 percent base interest rate.
